// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/language/expressions/tagged-template/cache-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var strings1, strings2;

strings1 = (function(strings) { return strings; })`1234`;
strings2 = other.$262.evalScript('(function(strings) { return strings; })`1234`');

assert.notSameValue(strings1, strings2);
})();

// One physical linked Script/template site must cache separately by realm.
const first = $262.createRealm();
const second = $262.createRealm();
const firstTemplate = first.evalScript('(strings => strings)`1234`');
const firstAgain = first.evalScript('(strings => strings)`1234`');
const secondTemplate = second.evalScript('(strings => strings)`1234`');
assert.sameValue(firstTemplate, firstAgain);
assert.notSameValue(firstTemplate, secondTemplate);
console.log("DS19 template complete");
